card.name: Hours in every X to Y hours
card.fires_on: The word "hours" right after a dosing interval range such as "every 4 to 6" or "every 3 to 4". It is seen in as-needed pain dosing instructions.

modes.label: Interval range
modes.description: "hours" closes a numeric range after "every" in a dosing schedule.
